speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
text: asked the Minister for Health whether any schemes are available to encourage administrative and support healthcare workers to stay and build their careers in the public healthcare sector.

speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
text: This includes ensuring competitive salaries, career development opportunities and safe working environments.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: We have the Award for Nurses’ Grace, Excellence and Loyalty (ANGEL) scheme for nurses, which is a financial retention scheme, very similar to the CONNECT Plan that we use to retain teachers.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: So, could I ask whether we can have a similar programme or just extend the ANGEL programme to the administrative and support staff, who work alongside our nurses and should be equally valued as well?

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: There are different considerations for different healthcare workers.

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: There is a large number of healthcare workers.

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: They make up a large proportion of the workforce in the public healthcare institution.

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: Hence, it becomes necessary to have a scheme like ANGEL to retain them, very much like why teachers, when they have a whole group of workers who are in the public sector that needs to be retained.

speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
text: So, that scheme was specifically meant for them.
